description: GitHub is a software development platform for hosting repositories, collaboration workflows, automation, and related developer services. It provides source control, issues, pull requests, CI/CD, package and security features, and AI-assisted tooling through GitHub Copilot.
summary: GitHub exposes public docs-content HTTP APIs on `docs.github.com/api`, a REST API and GraphQL API on `api.github.com`, a CLI (`gh`), and a hosted MCP endpoint at `api.githubcopilot.com/mcp/`.
